scope: Corollary 1.2 (Fixed complete coefficient rings) of the manuscript “Integral Donovan Finiteness over Witt Vectors” (preprints/Integral-Donovan-Finiteness-over-Witt-Vectors-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ab8478191fa023af), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let p be a prime, let R be a fixed complete discrete valuation ring of characteristic zero whose residue field ℓ is algebraically closed of characteristic p, and let M ≥ 1 be an integer. As G ranges over all finite groups and b ranges over primitive central idempotents of RG for which the residue block ℓGb̄ has a defect group of order at most M, the algebras RGb belong to only finitely many R-linear Morita equivalence classes.
